|last=Govind |first=Deepti |date=7 Feb 2017 |title=Ujjivan Financial Services launches small finance bank |url=http://www.livemint.com/Industry/BR7jv84s5ryVL7GyW8ef6J/Ujjivan-Small-Finance-Bank-to-offer-4-interest-rate-on-savi.html |work=Livemint}}{{Cite news |first= |date=6 Feb 2017 |title=Ujjivan Small |website=www.ujjivansfb.bank.in}} == History == Ujjivan Financial Services was founded in 2005 by [[Samit Ghosh]] as a [[Non-bank financial institution|non-banking financial company]] (NBFC).{{Cite web|title=The Men Who Made Microfinance Work|url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/work-in-progress/the-men-who-made-microfinance-work/32650/1|website=www.forbesindia.com|access-date=2025-11-27|language=en}} On 7 October 2015, Ujjivan Financial Services received an in-principle approval from the [[Reserve Bank of India]] (RBI) to set up a [[small finance bank]] (SFB).{{Cite news |date=14 Nov 2016 |title=Ujjivan becomes fourth entity to receive small finance bank license |url=http://www.livemint.com/Industry/dZ6ywVBwrNXMy3i28av4lK/Ujjivan-becomes-fourth-entity-to-receive-small-finance-bank.html |work=Livemint}}{{Cite web |date=16 September 2015 |title=RBI grants "In-principle" Approval to 10 Applicants for Small Finance Banks |url=https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=35010 |website=rbi.org}} At that time, the company had over 2.6 million customers and 464 branches in 24 states.{{Cite web|title=Ujjivan Financial Services Ltd|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/companies/ujjivan-financial-services-ltd|website=Fortune India|access-date=2025-11-27|language=en}} Ujjivan received its final banking license from the RBI on 11 November 2016, and Ujjivan Small Finance Bank commenced operations in February 2017.{{Cite web|title=How Ujjivan serves the masses|url=https://businessindia.co/magazine/corporate-report/how-ujjivan-serves-the-masses|website=Business India|date=2024-02-02|access-date=2025-11-27|language=en|first=Arbind|last=Gupta}}{{Cite news|title=Ujjivan Small Finance Bank gets RBI final nod for small finance bank|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/ujjivan-small-finance-bank-gets-rbi-final-nod-for-small-finance-bank/articleshow/55420151.cms?from=mdr|work=The Economic Times|date=2016-11-14|access-date=2025-11-27|issn=0013-0389}} In April 2017, the bank stated that it intended to convert all NBFC branches to SFB branches by the 2020 financial year.{{Cite news|title=Ujjivan SFB to convert all NBFC branches by FY20, enters Delhi|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/ujjivan-sfb-to-convert-all-nbfc-branches-by-fy20-enters-delhi/articleshow/58343432.cms?from=mdr|work=The Economic Times|date=2017-04-24|access-date=2025-11-27|issn=0013-0389}} It received the [[Scheduled Bank]] status from the RBI in August 2017.{{cite news |last1=Pani |first1=Priyanka |date=30 August 2017 |title=Ujjivan SFB receives scheduled bank status from RBI |url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/ujjivan-small-finance-bank-receives-scheduled-bank-status-from-rbi/article9836399.ece |work=The Hindu Business Line |publisher= |language=English}}{{cite news|title=We are targeting loan growth of 18-20% in FY18: Sudha Suresh, MD and CEO, Ujjivan Financial Services|url=http://www.financialexpress.com/industry/we-are-targeting-loan-growth-of-18-20-in-fy18-sudha-suresh-md-and-ceo-ujjivan-financial-services/841289/|work=The Financial Express|publisher=Financial Express|date=5 September 2017}} In October 2019, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank received approval from the [[Securities and Exchange Board of India]] to raise ₹1,200 crores (US${{To USD|12000|IND|round=yes}} million) in an [[initial public offering]] (IPO).{{Cite web|title=Ujjivan Small Finance Bank files draft papers for Rs 1,200 crore IPO - CNBC TV18|url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks/ujjivan-small-finance-bank-files-draft-papers-for-rs-1200-crore-ipo-4195601.htm|website=CNBCTV18|date=2019-08-19|access-date=2025-11-27|language=en}}{{cite web|author=Times of India|title=Ujjivan Small Finance Bank gets Sebi's go-ahead for Rs 1,200-cr IPO|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/ujjivan-small-finance-bank-gets-sebis-go-ahead-for-rs-1200-cr-ipo/articleshow/71706748.cms|website=Times of India|access-date=8 December 2025 }} The IPO opened on 2 December 2019 and the shares were listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE) and the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE) on 12 December 2019.{{Cite web|title=Ujjivan Small Finance Bank IPO completed, to be listed in stock exchanges today|url=https://indianexpress.com/article/business/market/ujjivan-small-finance-bank-ipo-completed-to-be-listed-in-stock-exchanges-on-thursday-6161489/|website=The Indian Express|date=2019-12-12|access-date=2025-11-27|language=en}}{{cite news|author=The Hindu|date=4 December 2019|title=Ujjivan IPO subscribed 166 times|url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/markets/ujjivan-small-finance-bank-ipo-subscribed-166-times/article30170218.ece|work=The Hindu|issn=0971-751X|access-date=27 November 2025}} In 2022, the board of Ujjivan Financial Services approved the [[Reverse takeover|reverse merger]] of itself into Ujjivan Small Finance Bank.{{Cite news|title=Ujjivan Financial board approves merger with Ujjivan SFB|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/ujjivan-financial-board-approves-merger-with-ujjivan-sfb/articleshow/94866478.cms?from=mdr|work=The Economic services|url=https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/banking/ujjivan-small-finance-bank-receives-rbi-approval-for-foreign-exchange-services/113936700|website=ETBFSI.com|access-date=2025-11-27|language=en|last=www.ETBFSI.com}} UJJIVAN SMALL FINANCE BANK |url=https://www.nseindia.com/companies-listing/corporate-filings-shareholding-pattern?symbol=UJJIVANSFB |url-status=live |access-date=11 February 2026 |website=www.nseindia.com}} In 2024, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank received an Authorised Dealer Category 1(AD–I) Licence from the RBI, enabling it to provide [[Foreign exchange market|foreign exchange]] services.{{Cite web|title=Ujjivan Small Finance Bank receives RBI approval for foreign exchange services|url=https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/banking/ujjivan-small-finance-bank-receives-rbi-approval-for-foreign-exchange-services/113936700|website=ETBFSI.com|access-date=2025-11-27|language=en|last=www.ETBFSI.com}} ==See also== {{Portal|Banks}} * [[Banking in India]] * [[List of banks in India]] * [[Indian Financial System Code]] == References == {{Reflist}} == External links == * {{Official website|https://www.ujjivansfb.bank.in}} {{Banking in India}} [[Category:Companies based in Bengaluru]] [[Category:Banks established in 2017]] [[Category:Small finance banks]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 2017]] [[Category:Private sector banks in India]] [[Category:2017 establishments in Karnataka]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
